text: REST API for adding up-to-date peer-reviewed citations and automated research searches to your own workflows
quote: Connect the Consensus API within your project to seamlessly integrate up-to-date peer-reviewed citations into your own custom workflow.

text: Official MCP server lets agent workflows pull citable scientific sources
quote: Power agent workflows that need citable scientific sources via the REST API or MCP server

text: REST API and MCP server expose the same retrieval and synthesis surface as the web app
quote: API and agent ready: a REST API and an MCP server expose the same retrieval and synthesis surface that powers the web app

text: Citation Graph maps a seed paper's references, the work it inspired, and studies commonly read alongside it
quote: The Consensus Citation Graph turns a single seed paper into a complete map of the work that built it, the work it inspired, and the studies most often read alongside it.

text: Import thousands of papers into your library in one click
quote: Import thousands of papers in one click - then search, find gaps, and put your collection to work.

text: Import papers from Zotero, BibTeX, PDF, or RIS
quote: Import from Zotero ... or import from BibTex, PDF, or RIS

text: Library turns your research collection into a searchable, AI-powered workspace
quote: Reference managers are great at saving papers — not so great at helping you use them. The Consensus Library brings your entire research library into one searchable, AI-powered workspace.

text: Find research gaps across your imported paper collection
quote: Turn your library into a research engine. Import thousands of papers in one click - then search, find gaps, and put your collection to work.

text: Analyzes full paper text, including paywalled papers from major publishers
quote: Consensus analyzes the full text, including paywalled papers from major publishers, so you can find the most relevant papers.

text: Searches over 200 million academic papers and uses language models to help find, understand, and synthesize literature
quote: It searches over 200 million academic papers and uses language models to help you find, understand, and synthesize the literature faster.

text: Research agent chains citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search, and similar-paper discovery
quote: Consensus has evolved from a search tool into a research agent. Citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search, similar papers, and more - chained together on top of the worlds best academic search engine.

text: Literature review workflow to search, screen, extract, and synthesize evidence transparently
quote: Consensus is an AI-powered research engine built to speed up literature reviews. Search, screen, extract, and synthesize evidence faster—while keeping full transparency and scholarly rigor.

text: Deep Search runs comprehensive literature reviews across many studies in minutes
quote: Deep Searches (more comprehensive Lit Reviews across many studies)

text: Every response includes citations that trace each insight back to its original source
quote: Every response includes citations, so you can trace each insight back to the original source.

text: Consensus Meter classifies relevant papers as supporting, refuting, or mixed for a yes/no question and shows the distribution
quote: The Consensus Meter is a visual aggregator that, for a yes/no/possibly question, classifies each relevant paper as supporting, refuting, or mixed/inconclusive, then displays the distribution.

text: Filter results by study type, publication year, journal, open-access status, and discipline
quote: Filters allow narrowing by study type (RCT, meta-analysis, systematic review, observational), publication year, journal, open-access status, and discipline.

text: Extracts population, intervention, comparator, and outcome (PICO) from papers where applicable
quote: Extracted population, intervention, comparator, and outcome (PICO) where applicable

text: Classifies each paper's study design, such as RCT, cohort, or case-control
quote: For each paper Consensus surfaces: Study design classification (RCT, cohort, case contro

text: Semantic search using AI embeddings understands natural-language questions
quote: Semantic search, powered by AI embeddings, to capture the intent behind your question and support natural language queries.

text: Re-ranks the top 1,500 papers by query match and by strength of the research
quote: we take the top 1,500 papers and re-rank them, not just by how well they match your query, but also by how strong the research is

text: Medical Mode limits answers to top medical journals and clinical guidelines
quote: Clinicians often need insights drawn only from top medical journals and clinical guidelines — the gold standard of evidence.That's why we're introducing Medical Mode in Consensus.

text: Threads turns isolated searches into ongoing conversational follow-ups over research
quote: Threads reimagines how you interact with peer-reviewed research by turning isolated searches into flowing conversations.

text: API and MCP option to exclude preprints and return only peer-reviewed papers
quote: pass `exclude_preprints=true` (MCP) or `excludePreprints=true` (REST API) to filter to peer-reviewed papers only.
